generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The idempotency check within the validation loop returns from the method immediately (`return response;`) when a `TopicConfig` is found to be identical to the existing configuration. In a batch request, this prevents all subsequent topics in the list from being validated or updated if any preceding topic is already up-to-date. This should be changed to skip the current iteration (e.g., using `continue`) or filter the list before processing.

The metrics recording logic uses `TopicValidator.isSystemTopic(topicNames)`, where `topicNames` is a semicolon-delimited string of all topic names in the request. Since `isSystemTopic` expects a single topic name, this check will not correctly identify if any individual topic in the batch is a system topic, rendering the metric inaccurate for batch operations.
